title: fix(app-shell,plugin-detail): a record open sends one approvals read and one record read (objectui#12701)
body:
Fixes #12701
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

**Target 1, approvals: one read per record open, shared by every consumer.** `useRecordApprovals` now keeps the read and its answer in a module-scoped store keyed by object + record. This is the same structural choice as `hooks/sharedUserFeeds.ts`: no provider is needed above every call site, so no consumer can opt out. It has no polling. Every instance mounted for a record shares one `GET /approvals/requests?object=…&recordId=…`. A consumer that mounts later (an authored `record:approvals` block, a tab opened after load) is served the stored answer, and a read already on the wire is joined. The entry lives while any consumer is mounted, so opening the record again reads it again. `refresh()` always reads (after a decision or a saved edit), and every consumer of the record sees the result. In `RecordDetailView`, the approvals invalidation effect now fires only when the invalidation nonce actually moves; it used to skip only its first run.

**Target 2, the record: one fetch.** `record:details` passes `DetailView` a new prop, `recordFromHost`. With it, the body never reads the record itself: while `schema.data` is absent for the record the host names, it shows its loading state, and it renders the page's record when that arrives. A host that names no record (a binding with no row) renders exactly what it rendered before. Without the prop, `DetailView` reads its record as before. The page's own read already expands every relation the viewer may read, which covers any section's list. When that list grows (the definition gains a relation), the page reads once more with the union, and the body still sends nothing.

**Target 3:** `RecordDetailView.recordOpenRequests-12701.test.tsx` counts requests by URL on the real page, the real adapter and the real hook, under `React.StrictMode` as the console renders it, on an authored page that also places `record:approvals`.

## What the measurement found

The three identical approvals reads were not three consumers. Caller stacks put all three on the page's one `useRecordApprovals`: two from its mount effect, which StrictMode replays in development, and the third from the page's skip-the-first-run invalidation effect, which the replay walked through. The fix also covers the genuine multi-consumer case (an authored `record:approvals` mounts a second hook instance), and the test pins that case. The second record read came from `record:details`' `DetailView`, reading the row while the page's read was still on the wire. That one is not StrictMode-related.

## Deviations

- `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx` is touched: it is the call site that passes the new prop.
- `RecordDetailView.recordOpenRequests-11699.test.tsx` is updated: its pin counted the body's own `GET /data/OBJ/ID` as 1, and that is the read this change removes. It now expects 0.
- New exported surface: the one `DetailView` prop, `recordFromHost`. The app-shell entry is unchanged; the store's test reset is exported from `useRecordApprovals.ts` only.
- The full app-shell suite exceeds the container's foreground time cap as one run, so it ran as six shards of the same file set.

## Network log, HotCRM, objectstack dev against the vite console

All requests naming the record, from one full page load each. Before = `e6175b57f`, after = this branch. The rest of each log is console boot reads (session, localization, runtime config, the bell's feeds), whose counts vary from run to run and do not reach this diff.

Lead `/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_lead/record/2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A`, before:

```
GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_lead
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=crm_lead&recordId=2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=crm_lead&recordId=2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=crm_lead&recordId=2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A
GET /api/v1/data/crm_lead?populate=organization_id,created_by,updated_by,owning_business_unit_id,owner_id,converted_account,converted_contact,converted_opportunity,duplicate_of_lead,duplicate_of_contact&top=1&filter=["id","=","2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"]
GET /api/v1/data/sys_comment?sort=created_at&filter=["thread_id","=","crm_lead:2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"]
GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?populate=actor_id&top=200&sort=timestamp&filter=["and",["object_name","=","crm_lead"],["record_id","=","2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"]]
GET /api/v1/data/crm_lead?populate=converted_account,converted_contact,converted_opportunity,duplicate_of_lead,duplicate_of_contact&top=1&filter=["id","=","2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"]
GET /api/v1/data/crm_task?top=1&filter=["and",["related_to_lead","=","2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"],[["status","not_equals","completed"]]]
```

After:

```
GET /api/v1/meta/object/crm_lead
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=crm_lead&recordId=2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A
GET /api/v1/data/crm_lead?populate=organization_id,created_by,updated_by,owning_business_unit_id,owner_id,converted_account,converted_contact,converted_opportunity,duplicate_of_lead,duplicate_of_contact&top=1&filter=["id","=","2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"]
GET /api/v1/data/sys_comment?sort=created_at&filter=["thread_id","=","crm_lead:2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"]
GET /api/v1/data/sys_activity?populate=actor_id&top=200&sort=timestamp&filter=["and",["object_name","=","crm_lead"],["record_id","=","2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"]]
GET /api/v1/data/crm_task?top=1&filter=["and",["related_to_lead","=","2ZErCkJGyOdJVC1A"],[["status","not_equals","completed"]]]
```

The lead has no approval request, so I also measured an opportunity that has a pending, record-locking request (created through the API: amount 200,000, which opens HotCRM's Large Deal Approval). Record-scoped approvals and record requests only, `/apps/app.objectstack.hotcrm/crm_opportunity/record/USK6xSbdaYCtPBCP`, before:

```
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=crm_opportunity&recordId=USK6xSbdaYCtPBCP   x3
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/areq_eaece249-467c-4686-9c84-500c192951eb          x3
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/areq_eaece249-467c-4686-9c84-500c192951eb/actions  x1
GET /api/v1/data/crm_opportunity?populate=organization_id,created_by,updated_by,owning_business_unit_id,owner_id,crm_account,primary_contact,crm_campaign&top=1&filter=["id","=","USK6xSbdaYCtPBCP"]
GET /api/v1/data/crm_opportunity?populate=primary_contact,crm_campaign&top=1&filter=["id","=","USK6xSbdaYCtPBCP"]
```

After:

```
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests?object=crm_opportunity&recordId=USK6xSbdaYCtPBCP   x1
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/areq_eaece249-467c-4686-9c84-500c192951eb          x1
GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/areq_eaece249-467c-4686-9c84-500c192951eb/actions  x1
GET /api/v1/data/crm_opportunity?populate=organization_id,created_by,updated_by,owning_business_unit_id,owner_id,crm_account,primary_contact,crm_campaign&top=1&filter=["id","=","USK6xSbdaYCtPBCP"]
```

The opportunity page draws the same thing before and after: the decision bar (Approve, Reject, Reassign, Send back, Request info, Recall, Reply), the Locked for approval band with Recall approval, the disabled Edit, and the details body. The lead page draws the same thing too. The record's `sys_activity` read is once before and once after; it is not duplicated.

## Tests, at the head this body names

Head `13a95b0` (origin/main merged in; no conflict):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/ --shard=K/6`, K = 1 to 6: every shard exit 0. 1471 of 1471 files (1 skipped), 13841 tests passed, 9 skipped.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail test`: exit 0. Test Files 276 passed, 1 skipped; Tests 2666 passed, 14 skipped.
- `type-check` for both packages, including their test tsconfigs: exit 0. Build of `@object-ui/app-shell` and its dependency closure, including plugin-detail: 29 of 29 tasks. `eslint --no-inline-config` on the touched files: 0 errors.
- `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check-changeset-presence`: all exit 0.

Each new pin was ablated once. Each mutation was confirmed on disk, the targeted test went red, and the file was restored with `git diff HEAD` empty:

- every mount reading: approvals reads 4;
- the nonce guard removed: approvals reads 3;
- `recordFromHost` removed from `record:details`: record reads 2, and the objectui#11699 pin also goes red;
- the DetailView guard disabled: findOne called once;
- the shared read publishing no rows: the CONTROL goes red;
- the expand list dropped from the record effect's dependencies: the union test reads 1 instead of 2.

## Acceptance notes

- In development, after a `git merge` under a running vite dev server, the HMR graph kept serving the old `record-details` module and the second record read reappeared. A fresh dev server reads 1. This is a dev-server artifact, not a code defect.
- The opportunity page's related-list previews read each relation twice, once with `top=3` and once with `top=1` (as filtered count reads): quotes, line items and tasks. These are different queries, outside this change.
- Production builds do not double-invoke effects. The approvals read was likely already 1 per open there on synthesized pages; not measured.
